examples.input:
from datetime import timedelta
Promo('sale', NOW - timedelta(days=1)).expired

test_promo_expired.title: test_promo_expired
test_promo_expired.code:
def test_promo_expired():
    past_time = NOW - timedelta(seconds=3)
    twitter_promo = Promo('twitter', past_time)
    assert twitter_promo.expired

test_promo_not_expired.title: test_promo_not_expired
test_promo_not_expired.code:
def test_promo_not_expired():
    future_date = NOW + timedelta(days=1)
    newsletter_promo = Promo('newsletter', future_date)
    assert not newsletter_promo.expired

test_expired_is_read_only.title: test_expired_is_read_only
test_expired_is_read_only.code:
def test_expired_is_read_only():
    promo = Promo('old', NOW - timedelta(days=1))
    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
        promo.expired = False

test_expired_follows_a_new_date.title: test_expired_follows_a_new_date
test_expired_follows_a_new_date.code:
def test_expired_follows_a_new_date():
    promo = Promo('moving', NOW + timedelta(days=1))
    assert not promo.expired
    promo.expires = NOW - timedelta(days=1)
    assert promo.expired

test_expiry_boundary_and_boolean_result.title: test_expiry_boundary_and_boolean_result
test_expiry_boundary_and_boolean_result.code:
def test_expiry_boundary_and_boolean_result():
    assert Promo('equal', NOW).expired is False
    assert Promo('before', NOW - timedelta(microseconds=1)).expired is True
    assert Promo('after', NOW + timedelta(microseconds=1)).expired is False

test_constructor_preserves_values_and_em.title: test_constructor_preserves_values_and_empty_name
test_constructor_preserves_values_and_em.code:
def test_constructor_preserves_values_and_empty_name():
    promo = Promo('', NOW)
    assert promo.name == ''
    assert promo.expires == NOW

test_expired_can_become_current_again.title: test_expired_can_become_current_again
test_expired_can_become_current_again.code:
def test_expired_can_become_current_again():
    promo = Promo('extended', NOW - timedelta(days=1))
    assert promo.expired is True
    promo.expires = NOW + timedelta(days=1)
    assert promo.expired is False
